title: retanilla patagonica

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
